name: Mizuwa Akihito
source:
Role: Clown
Role in the Coμ: Bishop

He is the protagonist of the story and one of the five people who control Babylon. A self-confessed feminist who never refuses to help any girl in trouble. His kindness to girls is caused by the death of his mother five years ago.
